zh.title: Talon Blue 完成首次全自主飛行　諾斯洛普格拉曼推進低成本無人機測試
zh.summary: 諾斯洛普格拉曼表示，YFQ-48A Talon Blue 已在美國加州莫哈維完成首次全自主飛行，涵蓋滑行、起飛、空中機動與降落。
body: 諾斯洛普格拉曼表示，YFQ-48A Talon Blue 已在美國加州莫哈維完成首次全自主飛行，涵蓋滑行、起飛、空中機動與降落。公司於10月3日公佈這項進展，目標透過模組化設計與製造改良，縮減零件數、重量及生產成本。
Talon Blue 採高置進氣口、寬輪距與內置武器艙設計，供美國及盟國評估不同任務需求。同屬 Project Talon 的 Talon IQ 則以 Scaled Composites Model 437 為自主技術測試平臺；首飛屬研發里程碑，並不等同航機已獲作戰部署認證。

en.title: Northrop Grumman reports first autonomous Talon Blue flight
en.summary: Northrop Grumman reports first autonomous Talon Blue flight.
body: Northrop Grumman says its YFQ-48A Talon Blue completed a first fully autonomous flight in Mojave, California, including taxiing, takeoff, airborne maneuvers and landing. The company announced the milestone on October 3, describing modular design and manufacturing changes intended to reduce parts, weight and production costs.

The aircraft combines a high-mounted intake, wide landing-gear stance and an internal weapons bay for different mission requirements. Project Talon also includes Talon IQ, an autonomy testbed based on the Scaled Composites Model 437 and powered by Prism mission-autonomy software. The announcement describes developmental progress; it does not establish that Talon Blue has entered operational military service.

facts.claim: Northrop Grumman reports first autonomous Talon Blue flight

image.subject: 中華航空認養苗栗加里山步道，華航總經理陳漢銘
image.sourceCaption: 中華航空認養苗栗加里山步道，華航總經理陳漢銘（左2）5日與農業部林業及自然保育署新竹分署長夏榮生（右2）等人進行認養牌揭牌。（華航提供）中央社記者余曉涵傳真　115年10月5日

zh.title: 華航認養南莊林地逾12公頃　估年碳吸存潛力236公噸
zh.summary: 中華航空10月5日表示，自2023年起認養的苗栗南莊林地已達12.425公頃，栽植約3萬3,801株臺灣杉、香杉等原生樹種，估計每年最多具有吸存236公噸二氧化碳的潛力。
body: 中華航空10月5日表示，自2023年起認養的苗栗南莊林地已達12.425公頃，栽植約3萬3,801株臺灣杉、香杉等原生樹種，估計每年最多具有吸存236公噸二氧化碳的潛力。這是林地碳吸存潛力估算，並非航空公司已取得的碳抵換額度。
華航並在加里山步道設置認養牌，支持大坪段0至0.6公里步道維護與設施改善。公司表示，林地已記錄石虎、藍腹鷴、臺灣野山羊等保育類動物活動，將持續推動森林復育及生物多樣性保育，讓遊客瞭解航空業參與在地生態維護的作法。

en.title: China Airlines expands Nanzhuang forest conservation project
en.summary: China Airlines expands Nanzhuang forest conservation project.
body: China Airlines said on October 5 that its adopted forest in Nanzhuang, Miaoli, now covers 12.425 hectares. Around 33,801 native trees, including Taiwan fir and incense cedar, have been planted. The airline estimates potential annual carbon sequestration of up to 236 tonnes of carbon dioxide, rather than reporting verified offsets already issued.

The carrier also unveiled a conservation sign at the Jialishan trail and supports maintenance along its Daping section. Recorded wildlife includes leopard cats, Swinhoe's pheasants and Taiwan serows. The project builds on the airline's forest and biodiversity commitment and combines habitat restoration with improvements to the local walking environment.

facts.claim: China Airlines expands Nanzhuang forest conservation project

zh.title: 西南航空推出 ChatGPT 外掛　首階段支援航班搜尋與行程規劃
zh.summary: 西南航空10月6日宣佈推出 ChatGPT 外掛，讓旅客在對話中探索目的地、搜尋西南航空航班並查看訂位選項。
body: 西南航空10月6日宣佈推出 ChatGPT 外掛，讓旅客在對話中探索目的地、搜尋西南航空航班並查看訂位選項。官方將這項服務定位為分階段導入人工智慧訂位流程的第一步，合作夥伴包括 OpenAI 與 Amazon Web Services。
航空公司表示，目標是在旅客開始規劃行程時提供更直接的航班資訊與購票入口，並逐步擴充功能。本次公告說明的是探索、搜尋及導向訂位選項，未宣稱所有付款、開票或售後手續都已能在 ChatGPT 對話內完成；實際購票仍須依官方流程辦理。

en.title: Southwest launches ChatGPT flight-discovery plugin
en.summary: Southwest launches ChatGPT flight-discovery plugin.
body: Southwest Airlines announced a ChatGPT plugin on October 6, allowing travelers to discover destinations, search for its flights and explore booking options through a conversational interface. The airline describes this as the first step in a phased approach to AI-powered booking developed with OpenAI and Amazon Web Services.

The initial service is intended to bring Southwest into the planning process earlier and create a more direct route from travel ideas to airline booking options. Southwest says capabilities will expand over time. Its announcement supports flight discovery and shopping; it does not establish that every payment, ticketing or after-sales transaction can already be completed inside a ChatGPT conversation.

facts.claim: Southwest launches ChatGPT flight-discovery plugin

zh.title: 聯合航空10月新增或恢復10條航線　涵蓋七座美國樞紐
zh.summary: Simple Flying 10月6日整理航班資料指出，聯合航空及 United Express 將在10月新增或恢復10條航線，涵蓋七座美國樞紐，其中五條過去未曾由這兩個品牌營運。
body: Simple Flying 10月6日整理航班資料指出，聯合航空及 United Express 將在10月新增或恢復10條航線，涵蓋七座美國樞紐，其中五條過去未曾由這兩個品牌營運。多數航線配合10月25日北半球冬季班表切換，並非全部都已開始飛航。
其中丹佛（DEN）—摩押航線排定10月7日恢復，華盛頓杜勒斯（IAD）—Owensboro 於10月13日啟動，芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）—東京成田（NRT）於10月24日恢復。新增名單亦包含洛杉磯（LAX）—勞德代爾堡（FLL）及紐瓦克（EWR）—聖克羅伊（STX）；各航線開航日期與班次仍依實際班表調整。

en.title: United adds or restores ten routes across seven hubs in October
en.summary: United adds or restores ten routes across seven hubs in October.
body: Simple Flying's October 6 schedule review lists ten United Airlines or United Express routes being introduced or restored during October, spread across seven US hubs. Five are new to the carrier's network, while the others restore previous links. Most starts coincide with the October 25 winter-schedule change.

Examples include Denver (DEN) to Moab beginning October 7, Washington Dulles (IAD) to Owensboro on October 13 and Chicago O'Hare (ORD) to Tokyo Narita (NRT) on October 24. Other additions include Los Angeles (LAX) to Fort Lauderdale (FLL) and Newark (EWR) to St. Croix (STX). The list mixes future launches and resumptions; dates and frequencies remain subject to schedule changes.

facts.claim: United adds or restores ten routes across seven hubs in October

zh.title: 空中巴士公佈一週買回97萬3,929股　支援員工持股與獎酬
zh.summary: 空中巴士10月6日公佈，9月28日至10月2日共買回97萬3,929股，合計加權平均買入價為每股190.9527歐元。
body: 空中巴士10月6日公佈，9月28日至10月2日共買回97萬3,929股，合計加權平均買入價為每股190.9527歐元。每日成交數量介於19萬4,153股與19萬5,000股之間，交易於 XPAR 與 XETA 市場執行。
公司表示，這些交易屬9月11日宣佈的股份買回計畫，用途為支持未來員工持股及股權獎酬安排。股東大會4月14日授權董事會最多買回已發行股本的10%，但該授權上限並不代表本週已買回10%；本次揭露依歐盟市場濫用規則辦理，數據範圍限於上述五個交易日。

en.title: Airbus discloses 973,929 shares repurchased over five trading days
en.summary: Airbus discloses 973,929 shares repurchased over five trading days.
body: Airbus disclosed on October 6 that it repurchased 973,929 shares between September 28 and October 2. The combined weighted-average purchase price was EUR190.9527 per share, with transactions recorded on the XPAR and XETA markets. Daily volumes ranged from 194,153 to 195,000 shares.

The purchases belong to a program announced on September 11 to support future employee share-ownership and equity-compensation plans. Shareholders authorized the board in April to repurchase up to ten percent of issued capital. That authorization is a ceiling, not the amount bought during this reporting week. The disclosure covers five trading days and was issued under the EU Market Abuse Regulation.

facts.claim: Airbus discloses 973,929 shares repurchased over five trading days

zh.title: 波羅的海航空airBaltic擬調整500至700個職位　個別安排尚未定案
zh.summary: airBaltic 10月5日公佈，為配合新版營運計畫，預估將調整里加、維爾紐斯與塔林基地約500至700個職位。
body: airBaltic 10月5日公佈，為配合新版營運計畫，預估將調整里加、維爾紐斯與塔林基地約500至700個職位。公司強調，數字仍可能在協商過程改變，包含與工會討論飛行員、空服員減少工作量，以及其他部門組織重整，不能直接解讀為700人已遭解僱。
公司預計10月中旬確立新組織架構，執行長 Erno Hildén 表示尚未對個別員工做出最終決定，將依法進行諮商並直接通知受影響同仁。這項人力調整反映公司希望使組織與成本配合未來營運規模；公佈預估職位數與完成所有員工安置仍是不同階段。

en.title: airBaltic plans workforce changes affecting 500 to 700 positions
en.summary: airBaltic plans workforce changes affecting 500 to 700 positions.
body: airBaltic said on October 5 that its revised business plan could affect approximately 500 to 700 positions across Riga, Vilnius and Tallinn. The estimate remains provisional and includes discussions with unions about reduced workloads for pilots and cabin crew, alongside organizational changes elsewhere in the company.

The airline expects its new organizational structure to be defined by mid-October. Chief executive Erno Hildén said no final decisions had been made about individual employees and pledged consultation in line with applicable requirements. The announcement concerns aligning staffing and costs with the carrier's future scale. It should not be read as confirmation that 700 employees have already been dismissed.

facts.claim: airBaltic plans workforce changes affecting 500 to 700 positions

zh.title: 華信表示花蓮航線不再申請減班　北高航線仍待商業評估
zh.summary: 華信航空董事長陳大鈞10月7日表示，10月調整花蓮航線後，目前沒有再申請減班的計畫。
body: 華信航空董事長陳大鈞10月7日表示，10月調整花蓮航線後，目前沒有再申請減班的計畫。高雄（KHH）—花蓮（HUN）已由每週七班減為五班，臺中（RMQ）—花蓮維持每週三班；花蓮航線載客率仍約兩至三成，成本降低但尚未轉虧為盈。
減班釋出的運能將投入離島，尤其高雄—澎湖（MZG）航線。對於恢復臺北—高雄服務的討論，陳大鈞表示可評估嘗試，但包機需要提早安排，並建立低載客率時的取消及旅客告知機制；交通部表示尊重業者評估，這並不是已確認重新開航的公告。

en.title: Mandarin Airlines rules out further requested Hualien frequency cuts
en.summary: Mandarin Airlines rules out further requested Hualien frequency cuts.
body: Mandarin Airlines chairman Chen Ta-chun said on October 7 that the carrier does not plan to request further reductions on its Hualien routes. Kaohsiung (KHH) to Hualien (HUN) has fallen from seven to five weekly flights, while Taichung (RMQ) to Hualien remains at three. Reported loads are still around twenty to thirty percent.

Released capacity will support island services, particularly Kaohsiung to Penghu (MZG). Chen also said a Taipei–Kaohsiung service could be evaluated, provided charter planning and procedures for low-demand cancellations are arranged in advance. The transport ministry would respect airlines' commercial assessments. These comments describe a possibility for evaluation, rather than a confirmed relaunch or a ticket-sales announcement.

facts.claim: Mandarin Airlines rules out further requested Hualien frequency cuts

zh.title: 瑞典Gripen戰機協助波蘭空防　波方稱俄軍攻擊期間未偵獲越界
zh.summary: AeroTime 引述波蘭武裝部隊作戰司令部表示，瑞典 Gripen 戰機在10月6日至7日俄羅斯對烏克蘭大規模飛彈、無人機攻擊期間，支援波蘭空防。
body: AeroTime 引述波蘭武裝部隊作戰司令部表示，瑞典 Gripen 戰機在10月6日至7日俄羅斯對烏克蘭大規模飛彈、無人機攻擊期間，支援波蘭空防。波方在7日上午發布任務結束訊息，並稱沒有偵獲波蘭領空遭侵犯；這不等同宣佈瑞典戰機曾擊落俄軍目標。
瑞典此前宣佈自10月起支援北約在波蘭的整合防空與飛彈防禦，航機主要以瑞典為基地，另有較小規模前進部署於波蘭，任務包含保護援助烏克蘭的物流樞紐。報導指出，瑞典另規劃12月起部署約100人的 Patriot 防空單位，相關任務預計延續至2027年上半年。

en.title: Swedish Gripens support Polish air defense during Russian strikes
en.summary: Swedish Gripens support Polish air defense during Russian strikes.
body: Swedish Gripen fighters supported Polish air-defense operations during Russia's overnight missile and drone attacks on Ukraine on October 6–7, AeroTime reported, citing Poland's operational command. The command said the aviation operation had ended and that it had recorded no violation of Polish airspace. It did not announce a Swedish shootdown.

Sweden had previously outlined an October deployment supporting NATO's integrated air and missile defense in Poland, with aircraft primarily based in Sweden and a smaller forward presence in Poland. Tasks include protecting the logistics hub supporting Ukraine. A separate Swedish Patriot deployment of around one hundred personnel is planned from December into the first half of 2027.

facts.claim: Swedish Gripens support Polish air defense during Russian strikes

zh.title: 達美A350與加拿大航空777在洛杉磯碰撞　無人受傷、FAA展開調查
zh.summary: 達美航空一架空中巴士A350-900於10月6日在洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）滑行準備起飛時，左翼尖碰到加拿大航空波音777-200LR的水平尾翼。
body: 達美航空一架空中巴士A350-900於10月6日在洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）滑行準備起飛時，左翼尖碰到加拿大航空波音777-200LR的水平尾翼。Simple Flying 引述 FAA 說明，加航航機當時正在拖曳，並停在登機門前方；兩機均退出營運接受檢查及維修。
達美DL7原定飛往東京羽田（HND），機上275名旅客及15名組員均未傳出傷勢，加航機上人員也無人受傷。涉事航機註冊號分別為N512DN與C-FIVK。FAA已展開調查，NTSB亦獲通知；航機位置、拖曳作業與航管指示的責任歸屬仍待釐清。

en.title: Delta A350 clips Air Canada 777 at Los Angeles airport
en.summary: Delta A350 clips Air Canada 777 at Los Angeles airport.
body: A Delta Airbus A350-900 clipped an Air Canada Boeing 777-200LR at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) on October 6. The FAA said Delta Flight DL7 was taxiing for departure when its left wingtip struck the other aircraft's horizontal stabilizer. The Air Canada jet was being towed and had stopped short of its gate.

No injuries were reported among Delta's 275 passengers and fifteen crew members, or aboard the Air Canada aircraft. Both jets were removed from service for inspection and repairs. Delta's Tokyo Haneda (HND) service used a replacement aircraft. The FAA is investigating, and the NTSB was notified; responsibility for the collision remains undetermined.

facts.claim: Delta A350 clips Air Canada 777 at Los Angeles airport

zh.title: Wizz Air 六條阿布達比航線延至2027年1月　安全與繞飛成本影響復航
zh.summary: Aerospace Global News 引述 Wizz Air 表示，原訂10月底恢復的六條歐洲—阿布達比（AUH）航線，延後至2027年1月10日。
body: Aerospace Global News 引述 Wizz Air 表示，原訂10月底恢復的六條歐洲—阿布達比（AUH）航線，延後至2027年1月10日。涉及克拉科夫、卡託維治、索菲亞、克盧日、拉納卡與布達佩斯，原因包括最新安全評估、伊拉克空域限制及燃油成本。
報導指出，EASA延長巴格達飛航情報區的衝突區域建議，避免該空域將增加歐洲往返波斯灣航線的飛行距離與營運負擔。Wizz Air認為現況使這些航線缺乏商業可行性；其他業者也有不同復航期限，不能把六條航線的延後概括為全部中東航班一律停飛。

en.title: Wizz Air postpones six Abu Dhabi routes to January 2027
en.summary: Wizz Air postpones six Abu Dhabi routes to January 2027.
body: Wizz Air has postponed six Europe–Abu Dhabi (AUH) routes from late October to January 10, 2027, according to a spokesperson quoted by Aerospace Global News. The affected origins are Krakow, Katowice, Sofia, Cluj-Napoca, Larnaca and Budapest. The airline cited updated security guidance, Iraqi airspace restrictions and current fuel prices.

The report says EASA extended conflict-zone guidance affecting the Baghdad flight-information region. Avoiding that airspace can lengthen European flights to the Gulf and raise operating costs. Wizz Air considers the affected routes commercially unviable under present conditions. Other carriers have separate resumption timelines, so this decision does not mean that every airline or every Middle Eastern destination is suspended.

facts.claim: Wizz Air postpones six Abu Dhabi routes to January 2027

zh.title: flydubai 駕駛艙攻擊調查出現新說法　路透消息人士稱嫌疑人早有計畫
zh.summary: Aerospace Global News 10月6日整理路透社與美聯社報導指出，flydubai FZ1073駕駛艙攻擊案調查出現新說法：消息人士稱，涉案副駕駛在加入航空公司前已計畫襲擊以色列，並曾搜尋營運特拉維夫航線的業者。
body: Aerospace Global News 10月6日整理路透社與美聯社報導指出，flydubai FZ1073駕駛艙攻擊案調查出現新說法：消息人士稱，涉案副駕駛在加入航空公司前已計畫襲擊以色列，並曾搜尋營運特拉維夫航線的業者。關於目標為班古里昂機場（TLV）的說法，仍屬引述調查消息，而非已公佈的最終認定。
9月30日由杜拜（DXB）飛往特拉維夫的班機，因駕駛艙暴力事件改降沙烏地阿拉伯塔布克（TUU）。紐西蘭警方另確認涉案人士2018至2019年間曾在當地接受部分飛行訓練，並檢視相關紀錄；各國調查仍在進行，嫌疑人的動機與完整行動經過仍須以正式調查結果為準。

en.title: Reports allege flydubai co-pilot planned attack before joining airline
en.summary: Reports allege flydubai co-pilot planned attack before joining airline.
body: Aerospace Global News summarized Reuters and Associated Press reporting on October 6 alleging that the co-pilot involved in flydubai Flight FZ1073 had planned an attack before joining the airline. Sources briefed on the investigation reportedly identified Ben Gurion Airport (TLV) as an intended target. Those allegations are not a published final investigative finding.

The September 30 flight from Dubai (DXB) to Tel Aviv diverted to Tabuk (TUU) after violence in the cockpit. New Zealand police separately confirmed that the suspect completed part of his flight training in the country during 2018–2019 and said records were being examined. Investigations into his background and the complete sequence of events remain ongoing.

facts.claim: Reports allege flydubai co-pilot planned attack before joining airline

zh.title: 華信攜國臺交打造機上音樂體驗　10月10日起播放臺灣民謠
zh.summary: 華信航空與國立臺灣交響樂團10月7日簽署機上音樂授權合作，宣佈自10月10日起播放國臺交錄製的樂曲。
body: 華信航空與國立臺灣交響樂團10月7日簽署機上音樂授權合作，宣佈自10月10日起播放國臺交錄製的樂曲。登機迎賓音樂將每月輪播〈滿面春風〉、〈一個紅蛋〉、〈窗邊雨〉、〈江上月影〉及〈月夜愁〉等臺灣民謠，讓旅客在客艙聽見在地作品。
降落後送客音樂則固定播放小約翰・史特勞斯輕歌劇《蝙蝠》序曲。雙方以「會飛的音樂廳」作為合作理念，簽約活動於臺北松山機場（TSA）舉行，並安排弦樂四重奏演出；華信董事長期待未來能辦機場或機上快閃，但現場演出仍是願景，尚非正式排定服務。

en.title: Mandarin Airlines partners with NTSO for cabin music from October 10
en.summary: Mandarin Airlines partners with NTSO for cabin music from October 10.
body: Mandarin Airlines and the National Taiwan Symphony Orchestra signed a cabin-music licensing agreement on October 7. From October 10, passengers will hear NTSO recordings, including Taiwanese folk melodies rotated monthly during boarding. The partnership aims to bring locally recorded orchestral music into the airline's domestic-flight experience.

After landing, the carrier will use Johann Strauss II's overture to Die Fledermaus as its farewell music. A string quartet performed at the signing event at Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA). The airline's chairman also expressed interest in future live performances at airports or aboard aircraft. Those performances remain an aspiration; the confirmed arrangement is the recorded-music program beginning October 10.

facts.claim: Mandarin Airlines partners with NTSO for cabin music from October 10

zh.title: 摩洛哥首架F-16 Block 72完成試飛　續推進交付前測試
zh.summary: 洛克希德馬丁10月6日證實，摩洛哥皇家空軍首架F-16 Block 72已完成首次試飛，下一階段將持續飛行測試，朝首架交付推進。
body: 洛克希德馬丁10月6日證實，摩洛哥皇家空軍首架F-16 Block 72已完成首次試飛，下一階段將持續飛行測試，朝首架交付推進。公司稱這是摩洛哥未來空防能力的重要里程碑，但公告並未表示新機已交付或投入作戰。
AeroTime 報導指出，美國政府2019年批准摩洛哥採購25架F-16 Block 72的請求。洛克希德馬丁亦透過 Maintenance Aero Maroc 等合作案發展當地維修能量，包括規劃於 Benslimane 設置支援C-130重型維修與現代化的設施，未來再拓展至F-16等平臺。

en.title: Morocco's first F-16 Block 72 completes maiden test flight
en.summary: Morocco's first F-16 Block 72 completes maiden test flight.
body: Lockheed Martin confirmed on October 6 that the Royal Moroccan Air Force's first F-16 Block 72 had completed its maiden test flight. The aircraft is progressing through flight testing toward initial delivery. The manufacturer described the flight as a milestone for Morocco's future airpower, rather than announcing operational deployment.

AeroTime notes that the United States approved Morocco's request for twenty-five Block 72 aircraft in 2019. Lockheed Martin is also developing local support through partnerships including Maintenance Aero Maroc. A planned maintenance and overhaul facility at Benslimane is intended to support C-130 work, with potential expansion to platforms such as the F-16. These industrial plans are separate from completion of the fighter's acceptance process.

facts.claim: Morocco's first F-16 Block 72 completes maiden test flight

zh.title: 羅馬尼亞訂購12架H225M　啟動Puma機隊汰換
zh.summary: 空中巴士10月7日宣佈，羅馬尼亞簽約採購12架H225M多用途軍用直升機，透過法國軍備總局DGA締約，並納入歐盟SAFE防務融資機制。
body: 空中巴士10月7日宣佈，羅馬尼亞簽約採購12架H225M多用途軍用直升機，透過法國軍備總局DGA締約，並納入歐盟SAFE防務融資機制。新機將開始替換羅馬尼亞空軍的IAR-330 Puma，用於一般及特種作戰任務；本次公告是訂購，而非完成交付。
公司表示，選用H225M也將透過長期合作夥伴IAR支持羅馬尼亞工業能力。這是雙方在SAFE框架下的第二批直升機合約，先前另有七架H160及五架H145公共服務用途訂單。空中巴士公佈全球H225與H225M合計逾350架服役、累積超過100萬飛行小時，兩型數量不應全算成軍用H225M。

en.title: Romania orders twelve H225M helicopters under EU SAFE financing
en.summary: Romania orders twelve H225M helicopters under EU SAFE financing.
body: Airbus announced on October 7 that Romania has signed for twelve H225M multirole military helicopters through France's DGA procurement agency under the EU SAFE financing framework. The helicopters will begin replacing the Romanian Air Force's locally built IAR-330 Puma fleet for conventional and special operations. Delivery has not been announced.

Airbus says the selection will also support Romanian industry through its longstanding partnership with IAR. The agreement follows separate SAFE orders for seven H160 and five H145 public-service helicopters. The manufacturer reports more than 350 H225 and H225M helicopters in service collectively, with over one million flight hours. That combined total should not be presented as the military H225M fleet alone.

facts.claim: Romania orders twelve H225M helicopters under EU SAFE financing

zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空試售Breeze航班　可累積Atmos點數、尚無聯程兌換
zh.summary: Simple Flying 報導，阿拉斯加航空已開始販售部分Breeze Airways獨立航程，初期涉及查爾斯頓（CHS）、拉斯維加斯（LAS）與羅利達勒姆（RDU）。
body: Simple Flying 報導，阿拉斯加航空已開始販售部分Breeze Airways獨立航程，初期涉及查爾斯頓（CHS）、拉斯維加斯（LAS）與羅利達勒姆（RDU）。透過阿拉斯加航空開立的合格機票，可累積Atmos Rewards點數；這是範圍有限的通路與會員方案測試。
目前旅客尚不能把阿拉斯加與Breeze航班組成同一張聯程行程，也不能以Atmos點數兌換Breeze航班，雙方未提供互惠高階會員權益。報導表示Breeze尚未反向銷售阿拉斯加航班，因此不宜將這項合作描述為完整的東岸接駁航網；行李、座位與取消條件仍須依訂位時顯示的規則確認。

en.title: Alaska tests Breeze ticket sales with limited Atmos earning
en.summary: Alaska tests Breeze ticket sales with limited Atmos earning.
body: Alaska Airlines has begun selling selected standalone Breeze Airways itineraries, Simple Flying reports. The initial test includes routes touching Charleston (CHS), Las Vegas (LAS) and Raleigh-Durham (RDU). Eligible tickets issued through Alaska can earn Atmos Rewards points, extending the airline's sales platform beyond its own flights.

The arrangement remains limited: Alaska and Breeze flights cannot currently be combined into one connecting itinerary, Atmos points cannot be redeemed on Breeze, and reciprocal elite benefits are unavailable. Breeze is not reported to be selling Alaska flights in return. Travelers should check the displayed seat, baggage and cancellation conditions rather than treating the trial as a fully integrated connecting partnership.

facts.claim: Alaska tests Breeze ticket sales with limited Atmos earning

zh.title: 沙國稱利雅得與艾卜哈機場遇襲釀3死36傷　涵蓋10月6至7日事件
zh.summary: AeroTime 10月7日引述沙烏地民航總局表示，10月6日至7日針對利雅得哈立德國王機場（RUH）與艾卜哈機場（AHB）的攻擊，造成三人死亡、36人受傷。
body: AeroTime 10月7日引述沙烏地民航總局表示，10月6日至7日針對利雅得哈立德國王機場（RUH）與艾卜哈機場（AHB）的攻擊，造成三人死亡、36人受傷。艾卜哈有兩名女性罹難、28人受傷；利雅得有一名蘇丹籍居民死亡、八人受傷，傷勢由輕至重。
葉門胡塞組織宣稱對兩座機場發動無人機與飛彈攻擊，沙國民航總局表示機場設施受損，正與安全單位評估並保護旅客及員工。本篇數字對應10月6至7日事件，與10月8日利雅得客機起火、10月9日公佈的另批傷亡不同，不能將兩則報導的人數互相替代或直接加總。

en.title: Saudi authorities report three deaths in October 6–7 airport attacks
en.summary: Saudi authorities report three deaths in October 6–7 airport attacks.
body: Saudi Arabia's civil-aviation authority reported three deaths and thirty-six injuries following attacks on King Khalid Airport (RUH) in Riyadh and Abha Airport (AHB) on October 6–7, according to AeroTime. Two women died and twenty-eight people were injured at Abha; one Sudanese resident died and eight were injured in Riyadh.

The Houthis claimed drone and missile strikes. The authority said airport facilities were damaged and that it was coordinating security assessments and protection for passengers and staff. These figures concern the October 6–7 incidents. They are separate from the later October 8 Riyadh aircraft fire and the casualty announcement made on October 9, and should not be substituted for that later toll.

facts.claim: Saudi authorities report three deaths in October 6–7 airport attacks

zh.title: Frontier準備接收首架前Spirit A321neo　新註冊號預定N814FR
zh.summary: Simple Flying 報導，Frontier準備接收原由Spirit營運的A321neo N731NK，預定改掛N814FR。
body: Simple Flying 報導，Frontier準備接收原由Spirit營運的A321neo N731NK，預定改掛N814FR。這架2024年製造的航機於9月28日由亞利桑那州Marana轉場至土桑（TUS），進行加入新機隊前的整備；公開紀錄所列仍是預定交付狀態。
航機屬Frontier向AerCap租賃的十架前Spirit A321neo之一，相關交付規劃落在2026年第四季至2027年第一季。報導指出，座艙將由Spirit的235席配置調整至Frontier的240席配置；此次安排利用較新的二手航機增加座位效率，不能把整批十架都描述為已投入營運。

en.title: Frontier prepares first former Spirit A321neo for delivery
en.summary: Frontier prepares first former Spirit A321neo for delivery.
body: Frontier is preparing to receive former Spirit Airbus A321neo N731NK, with the planned new registration N814FR, according to Simple Flying's review of fleet records. The aircraft was built in 2024 and moved from Marana to Tucson (TUS) on September 28 for work ahead of its next operator.

It is one of ten former Spirit A321neos leased from AerCap, with deliveries expected between the fourth quarter of 2026 and first quarter of 2027. The report describes cabin changes from Spirit's 235-seat layout to Frontier's 240-seat configuration. The transfer remains a delivery preparation milestone, rather than evidence that this aircraft or all ten jets have already entered Frontier passenger service.

facts.claim: Frontier prepares first former Spirit A321neo for delivery

zh.title: 坦尚尼亞EMB-120疑撞斑馬後迫降　30人全數平安
zh.summary: AeroTime 報導，一架載有26名旅客及四名組員的Embraer EMB-120，10月4日自坦尚尼亞Seronera起飛前往桑給巴爾時疑撞動物，因起落架無法完全放下，改降吉力馬札羅國際機場（JRO）。
body: AeroTime 報導，一架載有26名旅客及四名組員的Embraer EMB-120，10月4日自坦尚尼亞Seronera起飛前往桑給巴爾時疑撞動物，因起落架無法完全放下，改降吉力馬札羅國際機場（JRO）。機上30人均未受傷，註冊號5H-HLL的航機嚴重受損。
當地機場當局確認撞到有蹄類動物，媒體將其辨識為斑馬，但一側或兩側主起落架未伸出的報導仍有差異。機場約關閉五小時後恢復航班，事故調查已展開；營運人名稱在新聞報導與民航登記中也不一致，現階段不宜據此確定事故原因或歸責某家航空公司。

en.title: Tanzania EMB-120 makes emergency landing after reported animal strike
en.summary: Tanzania EMB-120 makes emergency landing after reported animal strike.
body: An Embraer EMB-120 carrying twenty-six passengers and four crew members made an emergency landing at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) after a reported animal strike during departure from Seronera on October 4, AeroTime reported. All thirty occupants escaped without injury, while aircraft 5H-HLL sustained substantial damage.

The airport authority reportedly confirmed a hoofed-animal strike, while local reporting identified a zebra. Accounts differ on whether one or both main landing gears failed to extend. Kilimanjaro closed for approximately five hours before flights resumed. Investigators have opened an inquiry, and reporting also differs on the operator's identity. The precise damage sequence and responsibility therefore remain subject to investigation.

facts.claim: Tanzania EMB-120 makes emergency landing after reported animal strike

zh.title: 達美冬季調整七條美國航線　部分市場轉由其他樞紐服務
zh.summary: Simple Flying 整理9月班表異動指出，達美航空將在11月初至2027年1月初撤除七條美國國內航線，包括拉斯維加斯（LAS）往聖地牙哥（SAN）、橘郡（SNA），以及西雅圖（SEA）往費城（PHL）。
body: Simple Flying 整理9月班表異動指出，達美航空將在11月初至2027年1月初撤除七條美國國內航線，包括拉斯維加斯（LAS）往聖地牙哥（SAN）、橘郡（SNA），以及西雅圖（SEA）往費城（PHL）。航空公司表示，調整是為使班表符合旅客需求。
紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）往密爾瓦基（MKE）、棕櫚泉（PSP）及達拉斯沃斯堡（DFW）也列入異動，部分城市仍保有達美其他樞紐航班。報導另列兩條季節性暫停服務，與永久撤線並不相同；將撤線直接歸因於資金轉投國際高價值市場，屬媒體分析，非航空公司已證實的因果。

en.title: Delta schedules seven US route cuts for the coming winter
en.summary: Delta schedules seven US route cuts for the coming winter.
body: Delta's September schedule filings remove seven domestic routes between early November and early January, according to Simple Flying. They include Las Vegas (LAS) to San Diego (SAN) and Orange County (SNA), plus Seattle (SEA) to Philadelphia (PHL). Delta describes the changes as adjustments to match customer demand.

Other affected services include New York JFK to Milwaukee (MKE), Palm Springs (PSP) and Dallas/Fort Worth (DFW). Several cities retain flights through other Delta hubs. The report distinguishes these cuts from two seasonal suspensions. Linking the reductions directly to funding premium international expansion is an analytical interpretation, rather than a cause independently confirmed by the airline.

facts.claim: Delta schedules seven US route cuts for the coming winter

zh.title: 澳洲紀念幣收錄黑盒子發明　向David Warren航空安全貢獻致敬
zh.summary: 澳洲國防部10月7日宣佈，皇家鑄幣廠「Bright Ideas」紀念幣系列將收錄飛航紀錄器，向澳洲科學家David Warren的發明致敬，系列預定10月8日上市。
body: 澳洲國防部10月7日宣佈，皇家鑄幣廠「Bright Ideas」紀念幣系列將收錄飛航紀錄器，向澳洲科學家David Warren的發明致敬，系列預定10月8日上市。其他主題包括無線區域網路、嬰兒安全提籃與農具等澳洲創新。
Warren在1950年代參與de Havilland Comet事故調查時，提出持續記錄飛行數據與駕駛艙聲音的構想，並自行製作原型。這項技術後來成為事故調查的重要工具，協助檢視飛行過程、改善設計與操作程序；紀念幣表彰的是發明與安全貢獻，並非發布新的航機裝備規定。

en.title: Australia honors flight-recorder inventor with commemorative coin
en.summary: Australia honors flight-recorder inventor with commemorative coin.
body: Australia's Department of Defence announced on October 7 that the Royal Australian Mint's Bright Ideas collection would include a coin honoring the flight recorder invented by David Warren. The collection goes on sale October 8 and also recognizes inventions including wireless networking and an infant safety capsule.

Warren developed his concept while working on investigations into de Havilland Comet accidents in the 1950s. He proposed recording flight data and cockpit voices continuously and built a prototype to demonstrate the idea. Modern recorders help investigators reconstruct accidents and improve aircraft design and procedures. The coin commemorates that contribution to aviation safety; it does not introduce a new aircraft-equipment requirement.

facts.claim: Australia honors flight-recorder inventor with commemorative coin

zh.title: 沙烏地航空集團評估新一批採購　仍待董事會批准招標
zh.summary: AeroTime 引述彭博訪問指出，沙烏地航空集團已完成未來成長及老舊機隊替換需求評估，正在等待董事會批准啟動需求建議書RFP程序。
body: AeroTime 引述彭博訪問指出，沙烏地航空集團已完成未來成長及老舊機隊替換需求評估，正在等待董事會批准啟動需求建議書RFP程序。集團策略主管Sanjiv Kapoor表示，採購將支援Saudia與flyadeal，首批新機預期2031年交付。
Kapoor未公佈確定採購數量，並表示訂單可能一次或分階段提出。因此，本次進展屬採購規劃與招標前準備，不是已簽署的大型訂單；先前市場流傳的架數與機型也不能視為本次正式確認。集團仍有既有Airbus、Boeing新機待交付，新增需求須與既有訂單分開理解。

en.title: Saudia Group prepares aircraft procurement subject to board approval
en.summary: Saudia Group prepares aircraft procurement subject to board approval.
body: Saudia Group has completed its assessment of aircraft needed for growth and replacement and is awaiting board approval to start a request-for-proposals process, AeroTime reported from a Bloomberg interview. Strategy executive Sanjiv Kapoor said the prospective purchase would serve both Saudia and flyadeal, with first deliveries expected in 2031.

Kapoor did not disclose a confirmed aircraft total and said the order might be placed together or in stages. This is procurement planning ahead of an RFP, rather than an announced firm contract. Earlier market reports about possible quantities and types should not be treated as details confirmed by this interview. The new proposal is also separate from aircraft already on order.

facts.claim: Saudia Group prepares aircraft procurement subject to board approval

zh.title: 巴西本土組裝首架Gripen E完成首飛　交付前驗收持續
zh.summary: Embraer 10月7日宣佈，首架在巴西組裝的Gripen E已於聖保羅州Gavião Peixoto完成首飛，由Saab試飛員駕駛，檢查主要系統與飛行特性。
body: Embraer 10月7日宣佈，首架在巴西組裝的Gripen E已於聖保羅州Gavião Peixoto完成首飛，由Saab試飛員駕駛，檢查主要系統與飛行特性。巴西空軍將航機登記為FAB 4109、型號稱F-39E；完成首飛後仍須進行生產試飛及驗收，才會交付。
這架航機是目前合約下15架巴西生產Gripen E的首架；2014年整體採購合約涵蓋28架單座E型與八架雙座F型，共36架。巴西與瑞典另就增購20架洽談，兩家公司亦簽署生產合作框架，但談判與框架文件不等於新增20架已完成正式訂購。

en.title: First Brazilian-assembled Gripen E completes maiden flight
en.summary: First Brazilian-assembled Gripen E completes maiden flight.
body: Embraer announced on October 7 that the first Gripen E assembled in Brazil completed its maiden flight at Gavião Peixoto. A Saab test pilot checked the aircraft's main systems and flight characteristics. Registered FAB 4109 and designated F-39E by the Brazilian Air Force, the jet now enters production flight testing and acceptance before delivery.

It is the first of fifteen Gripen E aircraft to be produced locally under the existing contract. The original 2014 agreement covers thirty-six fighters, comprising twenty-eight single-seat E models and eight two-seat F models. Brazil and Sweden are also negotiating a further twenty aircraft, but their discussions and industrial framework are distinct from a finalized additional order.

facts.claim: First Brazilian-assembled Gripen E completes maiden flight

zh.title: NTSB初步報告記錄NBC直升機墜毀前29秒警示聲　事故原因未定
zh.summary: NTSB公佈Chatsworth新聞直升機事故初步報告，確認AS 350 B2、註冊N358TV於2026年9月15日墜毀，造成機上兩人與地面一人死亡、另有地面一人輕傷。
body: NTSB公佈Chatsworth新聞直升機事故初步報告，確認AS 350 B2、註冊N358TV於2026年9月15日墜毀，造成機上兩人與地面一人死亡、另有地面一人輕傷。這項日期依原始報告核對，並非部分媒體文字所寫的10月15日。
報告指出，事故前最後29秒影片記錄到直升機聲音頻率改變，以及間歇與連續警示聲，與主旋翼轉速相關警示相符；ADS-B顯示航機右轉時快速下降，隨後撞擊地面並起火。這是調查中的初步觀察，尚未認定機械故障、飛行員操作或其他因素為事故原因。

en.title: NTSB details warning sounds before September news-helicopter crash
en.summary: NTSB details warning sounds before September news-helicopter crash.
body: The NTSB's preliminary report identifies September 15, 2026 as the date of the Chatsworth news-helicopter crash involving AS 350 B2 N358TV. Two occupants and one person on the ground died, while another ground injury was minor. The original document corrects an October 15 date appearing in secondary reporting.

Video captured changes in helicopter noise and intermittent and continuous warning horns during the final twenty-nine seconds, consistent with rotor-speed and other aural advisories. ADS-B showed a rapid descent during a right turn before impact and fire. These observations remain preliminary. The report does not establish mechanical failure, pilot actions or any other factor as the accident's probable cause.

facts.claim: NTSB details warning sounds before September news-helicopter crash

zh.title: 加歐峯會草案提50架滅火機　數量分配與既有訂單關係未明
zh.summary: AeroTime 引述Politico取得的加歐峯會聲明草案指出，雙方擬宣佈共同採購50架De Havilland滅火機，目標2030年在加拿大與歐洲使用。
body: AeroTime 引述Politico取得的加歐峯會聲明草案指出，雙方擬宣佈共同採購50架De Havilland滅火機，目標2030年在加拿大與歐洲使用。文件為9月流通、峯會前仍待協商的草案，不能當成已簽約交付的採購結果。
草案未說明50架如何分配，也未釐清是否包含既有歐洲22架DHC-515訂單。De Havilland先前表示已為六個歐洲國家生產相關航機，並與加拿大省份簽約；新提案與既有訂單的數量關係仍待正式文件確認。DHC-515為水陸兩用滅火機，後續應追蹤峯會最終聲明與製造商合約公告。

en.title: Draft Canada–EU statement proposes fifty firefighting aircraft
en.summary: Draft Canada–EU statement proposes fifty firefighting aircraft.
body: A draft statement for the Canada–EU summit proposes a joint purchase of fifty De Havilland firefighting aircraft for use in Canada and Europe by 2030, AeroTime reported, citing a document obtained by Politico. The text circulated ahead of negotiations and is not a finalized purchase contract.

The draft does not explain how the aircraft would be allocated or whether existing European orders for twenty-two DHC-515s would count toward the fifty. De Havilland has separately reported production for six European countries and contracts with Canadian provinces. The proposed commitment must therefore be distinguished from those existing orders, with final summit wording and manufacturer contracts still needed to settle the scope.

facts.claim: Draft Canada–EU statement proposes fifty firefighting aircraft

zh.title: 敘利亞航空推出綠金新塗裝　年底機隊與航點目標仍待落實
zh.summary: 敘利亞航空10月5日在大馬士革國際機場（DAM）發表新企業識別，以深綠與金色取代原先偏藍色系塗裝。
body: 敘利亞航空10月5日在大馬士革國際機場（DAM）發表新企業識別，以深綠與金色取代原先偏藍色系塗裝。首架採用新設計的A320-200為YK-AKJ，在捷克重新上漆後返回敘利亞，尾翼與引擎外罩使用Simurgh鳥圖案。
Aerospace Global News報導，執行長Anwar Akkad表示，目前六架營運航機的機隊希望年底增至12架，航網由年初九個航點擴大至25個。公司亦更新網站、訂位與付款功能，規劃11月初導入新訂位系統；這些機隊與航點數是成長目標，並非10月已全部達成。

en.title: Syrian Airlines unveils green-and-gold identity and growth targets
en.summary: Syrian Airlines unveils green-and-gold identity and growth targets.
body: Syrian Airlines presented a new corporate identity at Damascus International Airport (DAM) on October 5. Dark green and gold replace its earlier blue-heavy livery, with Airbus A320-200 YK-AKJ becoming the first aircraft in the new scheme after repainting in the Czech Republic. The design features a stylized Simurgh bird.

Aerospace Global News reports that chief executive Anwar Akkad aims to increase the operating fleet from six aircraft to twelve by year-end and expand the network from nine destinations at the start of the year to twenty-five. Digital upgrades include a new website and a reservation-system change planned for November. Those fleet and network figures remain targets rather than completed expansion.

facts.claim: Syrian Airlines unveils green-and-gold identity and growth targets

zh.title: 印度民航部長提兩年內在地製造民用機　合資夥伴與機型未公佈
zh.summary: 印度民航部長K. Rammohan Naidu表示，希望透過合資安排，在兩年內實現「印度製造」民用航空器。
body: 印度民航部長K. Rammohan Naidu表示，希望透過合資安排，在兩年內實現「印度製造」民用航空器。Aerospace Global News報導，部長在新德里活動上提出目標，但沒有公佈機型、合作企業或已定案的最終組裝計畫，因此仍屬政策與產業發展方向。
印度正討論多條區域航空器生產路徑，包括HAL與俄羅斯UAC的SJ-100合作，以及Embraer與Adani探索的區域航空產業鏈。部長未指明兩年目標對應哪個方案；既有Airbus–Tata C295則是軍用運輸機計畫，不能用其生產進度證明新的民用客機方案已落實。

en.title: India targets locally produced civilian aircraft within two years
en.summary: India targets locally produced civilian aircraft within two years.
body: India's civil-aviation minister K. Rammohan Naidu says a joint venture could produce a locally made civilian aircraft within two years, Aerospace Global News reported. Speaking in New Delhi, he did not identify the aircraft type or participating companies. The statement is therefore an industrial target, not a finalized assembly contract.

Possible pathways include HAL's work with Russia's UAC on the SJ-100 and Embraer's cooperation with Adani on a regional-aircraft ecosystem. Naidu did not tie his timetable to either project. The existing Airbus–Tata C295 program builds military transports and should not be presented as proof that a new civilian-airliner production plan has already been completed or selected.

facts.claim: India targets locally produced civilian aircraft within two years

zh.title: KLM首架A350已交付　新商務艙座椅仍待最終認證
zh.summary: KLM於10月2日接收首架A350-900，但Aerospace Global News 10月7日報導，新World Business Class座椅尚待最終認證，投入服務時暫不能販售相關座位。
body: KLM於10月2日接收首架A350-900，但Aerospace Global News 10月7日報導，新World Business Class座椅尚待最終認證，投入服務時暫不能販售相關座位。航空公司表示EASA已接受座椅測試結果，最終程序仍在進行；航機交付與座椅準售並非同一件事。
新機原規劃331席，包含34席商務艙、26席Premium Comfort及271席經濟艙，採用Stelia Aerospace OPERA商務艙套房。KLM稱延誤涉及監管要求的解釋變更；同集團法航的配置已有認證，並不代表KLM配置可自動適用。報導未確認最終批准日期，旅客需以實際可售艙等為準。

en.title: KLM's delivered A350 awaits final business-seat certification
en.summary: KLM's delivered A350 awaits final business-seat certification.
body: KLM received its first Airbus A350-900 on October 2, but the new World Business Class seat still awaits final certification, Aerospace Global News reported on October 7. KLM says EASA has accepted the test results while the remaining certification process continues. Aircraft delivery does not itself authorize sale of those seats.

The planned cabin has 331 seats: thirty-four business suites, twenty-six Premium Comfort seats and 271 economy seats. The business product uses Stelia Aerospace's OPERA suite. A separately certified Air France installation does not automatically approve KLM's configuration. The report gives no confirmed final-approval date, so passengers should distinguish the planned cabin from classes actually available for booking.

facts.claim: KLM's delivered A350 awaits final business-seat certification

zh.title: 日本航空羽田國內線貴賓室10月8日重開　新增工作與親子分區
zh.summary: 日本航空宣佈，東京羽田機場（HND）第一航廈北翼整修後的國內線貴賓室及專用安檢設施於10月8日重新開放。
body: 日本航空宣佈，東京羽田機場（HND）第一航廈北翼整修後的國內線貴賓室及專用安檢設施於10月8日重新開放。原Diamond Premier Lounge更名為JAL First Class Lounge，並將逐步在其他國內機場採用同名；北翼優先報到櫃檯已於7月先行啟用。
新貴賓室區分用餐、休息與工作空間，頭等艙貴賓室座位約增為原來1.4倍。Sakura Lounge另有親子區、電源插座及USB，並增設哺乳室與手機預約淋浴設施。這是國內線服務設施更新，不代表所有旅客都取得使用資格；入場仍須符合日航的艙等、會籍或其他適用條件。

en.title: JAL reopens redesigned domestic lounges at Haneda
en.summary: JAL reopens redesigned domestic lounges at Haneda.
body: Japan Airlines says its renovated domestic lounges and dedicated security facilities in the north wing of Haneda Airport (HND) Terminal 1 reopen on October 8. The Diamond Premier Lounge becomes the JAL First Class Lounge, with the naming change to extend progressively to other domestic airports. Priority check-in counters reopened earlier in July.

The redesign separates dining, relaxation and work areas, with First Class Lounge seating increasing to approximately 1.4 times its previous capacity. The Sakura Lounge adds family facilities and power outlets, while nursing rooms and smartphone shower bookings are also introduced. The renovation changes facilities, rather than granting universal access; passengers still need to meet the airline's applicable lounge-entry conditions.

facts.claim: JAL reopens redesigned domestic lounges at Haneda

zh.title: 漢莎集團2027夏季日本航班最多每週50班　恢復名古屋、增成田
zh.summary: 漢莎航空集團10月6日宣佈，2027年夏季日本航線最多增至每週50班，涵蓋旗下漢莎、瑞士、奧地利與ITA Airways服務。
body: 漢莎航空集團10月6日宣佈，2027年夏季日本航線最多增至每週50班，涵蓋旗下漢莎、瑞士、奧地利與ITA Airways服務。漢莎將恢復法蘭克福（FRA）—名古屋中部（NGO）季節性航線，自3月29日起每週三班，並自3月28日起增開每日成田（NRT）航班。
兩條漢莎航線規劃使用Allegris配置的787-9，瑞士航空則增加蘇黎世（ZRH）—成田服務至每週最多七班。集團日本航網涵蓋羽田（HND）、成田、大阪與名古屋，另有ANA合資合作提供轉機選項；50班是集團合計與未來班表上限，並不是漢莎單一品牌現已每週飛50班。

en.title: Lufthansa Group plans up to fifty weekly Japan flights in summer 2027
en.summary: Lufthansa Group plans up to fifty weekly Japan flights in summer 2027.
body: Lufthansa Group announced on October 6 that its airlines will offer up to fifty weekly flights to Japan in summer 2027. Lufthansa will restore Frankfurt (FRA) to Nagoya Chubu (NGO) three times weekly from March 29 and add a daily Tokyo Narita (NRT) service from March 28.

Both Lufthansa routes are planned with Allegris-configured Boeing 787-9s. SWISS will increase Zurich (ZRH) to Narita to as many as seven weekly flights. The group total includes Lufthansa, Austrian, SWISS and ITA Airways, serving Haneda (HND), Narita, Osaka and Nagoya. Fifty is a future maximum across the group, rather than a current frequency operated by Lufthansa alone.

facts.claim: Lufthansa Group plans up to fifty weekly Japan flights in summer 2027

zh.title: 美國國會研究報告列81架航機損失或受損　並非全數遭擊落
zh.summary: AeroTime報導，美國國會研究處10月5日更新報告，列出對伊朗作戰期間81架美軍航空器據報損失或受損，範圍包括有人固定翼機、直升機與無人機。
body: AeroTime報導，美國國會研究處10月5日更新報告，列出對伊朗作戰期間81架美軍航空器據報損失或受損，範圍包括有人固定翼機、直升機與無人機。統計包含可修復損傷，部分航機可能已恢復服役，不能將81架全部寫成被擊落或全損。
先前5月版本列42架，但差額也可能來自後續資訊補充，未必全是在5月之後新增的損失。報告綜合軍方聲明、新聞及監察資料；文中引用的19億至33億美元設備替換估算，範圍也不限於航空器。這些口徑區別有助避免把廣義作戰耗損誤解為單一類型的空戰結果。

en.title: CRS tally lists eighty-one US aircraft lost or damaged in Iran operations
en.summary: CRS tally lists eighty-one US aircraft lost or damaged in Iran operations.
body: A Congressional Research Service update dated October 5 lists eighty-one US aircraft reportedly lost or damaged during operations against Iran, according to AeroTime. The tally includes crewed airplanes, helicopters and drones, as well as repairable damage. Some aircraft may have returned to service, so the total is not a count of shootdowns or complete write-offs.

An earlier May version listed forty-two aircraft. The increase can reflect newly available information and does not necessarily measure losses sustained after May. The report draws on military statements, press reporting and inspector-general findings. A cited equipment-replacement estimate also covers more than aviation losses. Those distinctions are essential when interpreting the campaign's reported impact on US capabilities.

facts.claim: CRS tally lists eighty-one US aircraft lost or damaged in Iran operations

zh.title: 孟加拉航空確認訂購10架Airbus　四架A350、六架A321neo
zh.summary: 空中巴士10月7日宣佈，孟加拉航空Biman Bangladesh Airlines簽署十架客機確定訂單，包括四架A350-900廣體機與六架A321neo單走道機。
body: 空中巴士10月7日宣佈，孟加拉航空Biman Bangladesh Airlines簽署十架客機確定訂單，包括四架A350-900廣體機與六架A321neo單走道機。航空公司將從達卡樞紐運用A350拓展長程市場，A321neo則支援區域與中程航線，兩種機型的任務定位不同。
Airbus表示，新機將配合北美、歐洲與中東等國際航網規劃，提升航程與營運效率。這項合約是已確認的Airbus採購，與此前市場討論的十架全數A350方案不同；本次不是十架A350，也沒有公告已完成交付。製造商發布的燃油改善數據，係與前代競爭機型比較，不等同Biman整體營運已達相同比例減排。

en.title: Biman places firm order for four A350-900s and six A321neos
en.summary: Biman places firm order for four A350-900s and six A321neos.
body: Airbus announced a firm Biman Bangladesh Airlines order on October 7 for ten aircraft: four A350-900 widebodies and six A321neo single-aisle jets. The airline intends to use the A350 for long-haul growth from Dhaka, while the A321neo supports regional and medium-haul markets with a different capacity and range profile.

The manufacturer says the fleet will support Biman's plans for North America, Europe and the Middle East. The confirmed mix differs from earlier discussion of an all-A350 purchase, and no completed deliveries were announced. Airbus's efficiency comparisons refer to previous-generation competing aircraft; they should not be presented as reductions already achieved across Biman's entire operation.

facts.claim: Biman places firm order for four A350-900s and six A321neos

zh.title: 分析：西南航空TFP薪酬制　資深機長總報酬與底薪不能混算
zh.summary: Simple Flying分析西南航空2024年飛行員合約指出，資深機長在加計額外勤務報酬、退休提撥及利潤分享後，年度總報酬可能超過45萬美元。
body: Simple Flying分析西南航空2024年飛行員合約指出，資深機長在加計額外勤務報酬、退休提撥及利潤分享後，年度總報酬可能超過45萬美元。這是特定年資與工作安排下的總包裹估算，並非所有737機長都享有45萬美元固定底薪。
西南航空採Trip For Pay制度，依航段距離計算薪資積分，與多數航空公司以離開登機門至抵達時間計算的block hour不同。跨公司比較時，除了名目時薪，也須考慮積分換算、飛行排班與附加給付。報導屬合約及薪酬制度分析，沒有宣佈新的普遍加薪幅度或保證個人實領收入。

en.title: Analysis: Southwest's trip-based pay and senior captain compensation
en.summary: Analysis: Southwest's trip-based pay and senior captain compensation.
body: Simple Flying's compensation analysis says senior Southwest captains can exceed USD450,000 in annual total remuneration when premium flying, retirement contributions and profit sharing are included. The figure is a possible package under particular seniority and work arrangements, rather than a fixed salary guaranteed to every Boeing 737 captain.

Southwest's Trip For Pay system credits flying by distance, unlike conventional block-hour pay based on the time between leaving and reaching a gate. Comparing airlines therefore requires attention to credit conversion, schedules and additional benefits, not just headline hourly rates. The article analyzes the existing compensation structure; it does not announce a universal new pay rise or predict an individual pilot's take-home earnings.

facts.claim: Analysis: Southwest's trip-based pay and senior captain compensation

zh.title: 國慶疏運增高鐵自由座與跨日列車　措施日期須分開確認
zh.summary: 交通部10月8日說明國慶疏運安排，高鐵當日17時至21時增開八班全車自由座，從南港或臺北往臺中，並透過快速折返提升運能。
body: 交通部10月8日說明國慶疏運安排，高鐵當日17時至21時增開八班全車自由座，從南港或臺北往臺中，並透過快速折返提升運能。當晚22時20分南港往左營列車，排定隔日0時15分抵達，是鼓勵旅客離峯搭乘的跨日服務。
國慶疏運期間高鐵合計開行917班、其中加開92班；臺鐵另加開126班，西線新自強號取消自由座、乘車當日限量販售站票。上述自由座加開服務於10月8日執行，並非連假每日實施；後續服務與票種應依業者最新班表及公告確認。

en.title: Taiwan expands rail capacity and late-night trains for holiday travel
en.summary: Taiwan expands rail capacity and late-night trains for holiday travel.
body: Taiwan's transport ministry outlined National Day rail measures on October 8, including eight fully non-reserved high-speed trains from Nangang or Taipei to Taichung that evening. A separate 22:20 departure from Nangang to Zuoying was scheduled to arrive at 00:15 the next day, encouraging off-peak travel.

The holiday plan totals 917 high-speed services, including ninety-two additional trains, while conventional rail adds 126 services. Changes also affect reserved seating and limited standing tickets on western EMU3000 trains. These are dated October 8 arrangements, not departures still available tonight after delayed publication. Passengers should use operators' current schedules and ticket conditions for subsequent travel.

facts.claim: Taiwan expands rail capacity and late-night trains for holiday travel

zh.title: 華航長榮前三季營收創同期新高　客貨運需求共同推升
zh.summary: 中央社10月8日報導，華航與長榮航空9月及前三季合併營收均創歷年同期新高。
body: 中央社10月8日報導，華航與長榮航空9月及前三季合併營收均創歷年同期新高。華航9月營收209.33億元、年增31.86%，前三季1,859.2億元；長榮9月營收207.49億元、年增32.86%，前九月合併營收1,943.8億元，金額均為新臺幣。
兩家公司指出，連假帶動客運，半導體、AI伺服器及消費性電子出貨支持貨運，傳統淡季需求仍有支撐。臺灣虎航9月營收17.39億元、前三季156.21億元，前三季平均載客率91%。這些是營收與載運表現，不能直接當成獲利數字，年終貨運需求展望也仍是公司預期。

en.title: China Airlines and EVA report record nine-month revenue
en.summary: China Airlines and EVA report record nine-month revenue.
body: China Airlines and EVA Air reported record comparable-period revenue for September and the first nine months, CNA reported on October 8. China Airlines generated TWD20.933 billion in September and TWD185.92 billion over nine months. EVA reported TWD20.749 billion and TWD194.38 billion respectively.

Holiday passenger demand and shipments of semiconductors, AI servers and consumer electronics supported the results. Tigerair Taiwan also reported TWD1.739 billion in September revenue and TWD15.621 billion over nine months, with a ninety-one percent average load factor for the latter period. These figures measure revenue and traffic, not profit. Expectations for year-end cargo demand remain company outlook statements rather than realized results.

facts.claim: China Airlines and EVA report record nine-month revenue

zh.summary: Simple Flying更新後全文指出，WestJet卡加利（YYC）—聖保羅瓜魯柳斯（GRU）航線將於12月15日開航，每週三班使用787-9。
body: Simple Flying更新後全文指出，WestJet卡加利（YYC）—聖保羅瓜魯柳斯（GRU）航線將於12月15日開航，每週三班使用787-9。原規劃11月8日開航至翌年4月18日，後改為12月15日至2027年2月14日；補發採更新時程，不沿用先前「一個月後開航」標題。
這將是WestJet首條南美洲航線及最長航段，WS54去程排定12小時50分，WS55回程13小時45分，並非兩方向都固定14小時。航機配置320席，包含16席商務艙、28席Premium與276席經濟艙；實際首航及季節性營運仍須依航空公司後續班表確認。

en.title: WestJet's Calgary–São Paulo launch moves to December 15
en.summary: WestJet's Calgary–São Paulo launch moves to December 15.
body: Simple Flying's updated article places WestJet's Calgary (YYC) to São Paulo Guarulhos (GRU) launch on December 15, with three weekly Boeing 787-9 flights. The previously planned November 8–April 18 season has been shortened to December 15–February 14, 2027. The revised timing supersedes the older headline suggesting a launch in one month.

The service would become WestJet's first South American route and its longest sector. Scheduled times are twelve hours fifty minutes outbound and thirteen hours forty-five minutes on the return, rather than fourteen hours in both directions. The aircraft has 320 seats across business, premium and economy cabins. Actual operation remains subject to the airline's subsequent schedule updates.

facts.claim: WestJet's Calgary–São Paulo launch moves to December 15

body: 冰島航空與聖路易機場10月7日宣佈，2027年5月14日至10月24日將開行聖路易蘭伯特（STL）—冰島航線，每週最多四班，使用波音737 MAX 8。規劃營運日為週一、三、五、日，旅客可經冰島轉往歐洲；這是明年季節性服務公告，尚未首航。
雙方也將擴大與西南航空合作，利用其聖路易航網提供北美往返冰島及歐洲的轉機選項。機場公告將新航線定位為區域國際連結的一部分，實際聯程選項仍依兩家航空公司可售行程及營運安排。每週四班是上限，不能解讀為全年每日飛行，也不能把合作宣佈當成所有轉機產品都已開放販售。

en.title: Icelandair announces seasonal St. Louis service for May 2027
en.summary: Icelandair announces seasonal St. Louis service for May 2027.
body: Icelandair and St. Louis Lambert International Airport (STL) announced on October 7 a seasonal Iceland service from May 14 to October 24, 2027. Boeing 737 MAX 8 flights will operate up to four times weekly, on Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays, with onward European connections through Iceland.

The announcement also expands Icelandair's partnership with Southwest, using the latter's St. Louis network to provide connections across North America. This is a future seasonal route, not an inaugural flight already completed. Four weekly services is a maximum rather than a year-round daily frequency, and available connecting itineraries depend on the airlines' sales and operating arrangements.

facts.claim: Icelandair announces seasonal St. Louis service for May 2027

zh.summary: Simple Flying報導，Emirates正評估是否將35架787承諾轉為更多777X，並引述營運主管Adel Al Redha表示，轉換選項仍在討論。
body: Simple Flying報導，Emirates正評估是否將35架787承諾轉為更多777X，並引述營運主管Adel Al Redha表示，轉換選項仍在討論。公司可選擇按修訂時程接收787，或與波音協商轉換；這不是已完成的取消或新增訂單。
Emirates的787規劃歷經2017年初步承諾、2019年正式合約及2023年再調整。報導不同資料段落所列待交機數並不一致，因此本篇不以單一數字宣稱現行完整積壓訂單。可確認的是業者將交機延後、客艙需求與未來機隊安排納入評估，最終機型及數量仍須等雙方正式公告。

en.title: Emirates considers converting Dreamliner commitments to 777X
en.summary: Emirates considers converting Dreamliner commitments to 777X.
body: Emirates is considering converting its thirty-five-aircraft Dreamliner commitment into additional 777X aircraft, Simple Flying reports. Operating executive Adel Al Redha said conversion remains an option alongside accepting 787 deliveries under a revised Boeing schedule. The comments describe an assessment, not a completed cancellation or a new firm order.

The airline's Dreamliner plans have changed since its initial 2017 commitment, subsequent 2019 contract and 2023 revision. Backlog figures differ within the report, so they cannot reliably establish a complete current delivery total. Delivery delays, cabin requirements and future fleet needs are part of the discussion. Final aircraft types and quantities require a definitive announcement by the airline and manufacturer.

facts.claim: Emirates considers converting Dreamliner commitments to 777X

zh.title: Elixir約60架輕型飛機維持停飛　法國調查襟翼脫落原因
zh.summary: AeroTime引述法國BEA 10月8日更新指出，10月1日Elixir試飛事故中，航機在Rochefort-Charente-Maritime機場（RCO）進場轉彎時左襟翼脫落，隨後失控墜毀，兩名公司飛行員死亡。
body: AeroTime引述法國BEA 10月8日更新指出，10月1日Elixir試飛事故中，航機在Rochefort-Charente-Maritime機場（RCO）進場轉彎時左襟翼脫落，隨後失控墜毀，兩名公司飛行員死亡。涉事航機為F-WZAG、序號065；襟翼為何脫落尚未確定。
製造商10月2日發布警示服務通報，要求約60架航機自3日起停飛至另行通知。EASA緊急適航指令2026-0191-E同樣於10月3日生效，禁止Elixir型航機飛航，不限序號。這是調查期間的預防措施，不能據此宣稱全部航機都已有相同結構損傷，復飛條件仍待進一步公告。

en.title: Elixir fleet remains grounded while flap separation is investigated
en.summary: Elixir fleet remains grounded while flap separation is investigated.
body: The Elixir fleet remains grounded after an October 1 test-flight crash killed two company pilots in France. AeroTime cites an October 8 BEA update stating that the left flap separated during the final turn toward Rochefort-Charente-Maritime Airport (RCO). Investigators have not established why the component detached.

The manufacturer issued a precautionary grounding bulletin covering approximately sixty aircraft. EASA emergency directive 2026-0191-E, effective October 3, prohibits flight operations for the Elixir type regardless of serial number. The grounding is an interim response while the investigation continues, rather than proof that every aircraft has identical structural damage. A return to service depends on further regulatory and manufacturer action.

facts.claim: Elixir fleet remains grounded while flap separation is investigated

zh.title: 美航AA37六間廁所失效改降紐約　檢查後續飛達拉斯
zh.summary: 美國航空AA37於10月6日從馬德里（MAD）飛往達拉斯沃斯堡（DFW）途中，因波音777八間廁所中六間停止運作，改降紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）。
body: 美國航空AA37於10月6日從馬德里（MAD）飛往達拉斯沃斯堡（DFW）途中，因波音777八間廁所中六間停止運作，改降紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）。機上有275名旅客及12名組員，只剩兩間可用廁所；FAA確認機組因可用設施不足決定改降。
AeroTime報導，美航表示航機正常降落，接受維修檢查後繼續飛往達拉斯，但未公佈故障原因。機組曾發出PAN-PAN緊急程度較低的急迫通報，不能描述為航機失去控制或機械原因已確定。過往其他公司的廁所堵塞案例，也不能拿來推定本次是旅客亂丟物品造成。

en.title: American AA37 diverts to JFK after six lavatories fail
en.summary: American AA37 diverts to JFK after six lavatories fail.
body: American Airlines Flight AA37 diverted from its Madrid (MAD)–Dallas/Fort Worth (DFW) route to New York JFK on October 6 after six of eight Boeing 777 lavatories stopped working. The flight carried 275 passengers and twelve crew members, leaving only two working toilets. The FAA confirmed insufficient available lavatories prompted the diversion.

American told AeroTime that the aircraft landed normally and continued to Dallas after a maintenance inspection. The airline has not explained the failures. The crew made a PAN-PAN urgency call, which should not be described as a loss-of-control event. Plumbing problems on unrelated flights do not establish that passenger misuse caused this incident.

facts.claim: American AA37 diverts to JFK after six lavatories fail

zh.title: 聯合航空暫停機長飛行勤務　針對社羣貼文爭議進行內部審查
zh.summary: AeroTime報導，聯合航空確認機長Ibrahim R. Mossallam已暫停飛行勤務，等待內部審查。
body: AeroTime報導，聯合航空確認機長Ibrahim R. Mossallam已暫停飛行勤務，等待內部審查。該機長2023年就10月7日攻擊事件的社羣發言曾引發爭議並被暫停勤務，之後復飛；航空公司未說明本次審查是否涉及新的貼文或其他行為。
近期媒體另提出其他飛行員入駕駛艙監看、工會阻止解僱等說法，但航班日期、人員與具體細節未獲獨立核實，聯合航空亦未公開回應。現階段可以確認的是勤務暫停與審查，不能將網路傳聞當成已證實的飛安事件，也不能以社羣爭議直接判定當事人已被解僱。

en.title: United withholds pilot from flight duty pending review
en.summary: United withholds pilot from flight duty pending review.
body: United Airlines has confirmed that Captain Ibrahim R. Mossallam is being withheld from flight duty pending an internal review, AeroTime reported. The pilot previously faced scrutiny over social-media comments about the October 7, 2023 attacks and later returned to flying. United has not explained whether the latest review concerns new posts or other conduct.

Additional media claims about fellow pilots monitoring him from the cockpit and union intervention have not been independently verified. The reports do not identify the relevant flight, date or pilots. The confirmed development is a duty restriction and review, not a proven flight-safety incident or an announced dismissal. Unverified allegations should remain clearly distinguished from the airline's statement.

facts.claim: United withholds pilot from flight duty pending review

zh.title: FAA要求部分GP7200引擎更換渦輪密封件　非所有A380一律停飛
zh.summary: FAA 10月8日發布適航指令，要求部分Engine Alliance GP7270、GP7272及GP7277引擎更換高壓渦輪級間密封件。
body: FAA 10月8日發布適航指令，要求部分Engine Alliance GP7270、GP7272及GP7277引擎更換高壓渦輪級間密封件。AeroTime報導，規則針對15個特定高循環零件，10月23日生效，最緊急組別須在50個飛行循環或30天內更換，以先到者為準。
指令源於A380引擎密封件非包容性失效、停機並中止起飛的通報，完整根本原因仍在調查。適用範圍取決於指定零件與組別，不是全部A380或所有同系列引擎都須停飛；其他組別有不同期限。報導未公佈涉事航空公司及航機註冊號，營運人應依正式指令確認各件符合性要求。

en.title: FAA requires seal replacement on specified GP7200-series engines
en.summary: FAA requires seal replacement on specified GP7200-series engines.
body: The FAA published a directive on October 8 requiring replacement of specified high-pressure turbine interstage seals in Engine Alliance GP7270, GP7272 and GP7277 engines, AeroTime reports. The rule addresses fifteen identified components and takes effect October 23. The most urgent group has a limit of fifty flight cycles or thirty days, whichever occurs first.

An uncontained seal failure, engine shutdown and aborted A380 takeoff prompted the action. The root cause remains under investigation. Applicability depends on identified parts and compliance groups; the directive does not ground every A380 or every GP7200-series engine. Other groups have different deadlines, and the report does not identify the original airline or aircraft registration.

facts.claim: FAA requires seal replacement on specified GP7200-series engines

zh.title: 美航AA1239疑燃油洩漏折返波士頓　航空公司確認機械問題
zh.summary: 美國航空確認，10月5日AA1239因機械問題折返波士頓洛根機場（BOS），安全降落並自行滑行至登機門。
body: 美國航空確認，10月5日AA1239因機械問題折返波士頓洛根機場（BOS），安全降落並自行滑行至登機門。Simple Flying引述航管通訊，機組在飛往芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）途中報告右引擎疑似燃油洩漏並宣佈緊急狀況；「疑似洩漏」仍非已公佈的最終故障診斷。
涉事航機為737-800、註冊N812NN，機上共160人，約起飛45分鐘後返回。航空公司調派另一架737-800完成航程，旅客最終抵達約延遲17小時10分。報導沒有證據把航機年齡直接列為事故原因，機械問題與維修判定仍需分開描述。

en.title: American AA1239 returns to Boston after reported suspected fuel leak
en.summary: American AA1239 returns to Boston after reported suspected fuel leak.
body: American Airlines confirmed that Flight AA1239 returned to Boston Logan (BOS) on October 5 because of a mechanical issue, landed safely and taxied to its gate. Simple Flying reports that the crew declared an emergency after describing a suspected right-engine fuel leak while bound for Chicago O'Hare (ORD). That description is not a final diagnosis.

The Boeing 737-800, registered N812NN, carried 160 people and returned approximately forty-five minutes after departure. A replacement 737-800 completed the journey, with arrival reported roughly seventeen hours ten minutes late. The aircraft's age does not establish the cause. The reported symptoms and any definitive maintenance findings should remain distinct.

facts.claim: American AA1239 returns to Boston after reported suspected fuel leak

zh.title: 橘郡機場旅客涉偷拖車撞擊　警方逮捕、航機作業短暫中斷
zh.summary: AeroTime引述機場與警方表示，一名原搭達美前往西雅圖的旅客，10月6日在約翰韋恩機場（SNA）經緊急通道進入機坪，涉嫌駕走拖車並撞上工作車，之後又試圖取得廁所服務車，遭機場警方逮捕。
body: AeroTime引述機場與警方表示，一名原搭達美前往西雅圖的旅客，10月6日在約翰韋恩機場（SNA）經緊急通道進入機坪，涉嫌駕走拖車並撞上工作車，之後又試圖取得廁所服務車，遭機場警方逮捕。這些是警方指控，尚非司法定罪結果。
警方辨識當事人為26歲Skyler Jay Barr，涉及車輛竊盜、侵入及毀損指控，並送醫評估。保安事件造成航機移動短暫暫停，工作人員檢查相關滑行路段是否有碎片後恢復作業；達美表示配合執法調查。報導未表示旅客成功駕走或操縱航空器。

en.title: Passenger arrested after alleged tug theft at John Wayne Airport
en.summary: Passenger arrested after alleged tug theft at John Wayne Airport.
body: A passenger scheduled to fly Delta to Seattle was arrested after allegedly entering the airfield at John Wayne Airport (SNA) through an emergency-access door on October 6, AeroTime reports. Airport officials say he took a tug, struck a utility cart and then attempted to take a lavatory-service truck before police intervened.

Authorities identified the suspect as twenty-six-year-old Skyler Jay Barr and reported vehicle-theft, trespass and vandalism charges. He was taken for medical evaluation. Aircraft movements stopped briefly while staff inspected the affected taxiway for debris, and Delta said it was cooperating with investigators. The account concerns alleged ground-vehicle theft, not control of an aircraft, and charges are not convictions.

facts.claim: Passenger arrested after alleged tug theft at John Wayne Airport

zh.title: 媒體稱印尼J-10可能2027年4月抵達　數量與型別仍未確認
zh.summary: AeroTime引述印尼Republika及南華早報指出，印尼首批中國製J-10戰機可能約2027年4月抵達。
body: AeroTime引述印尼Republika及南華早報指出，印尼首批中國製J-10戰機可能約2027年4月抵達。印尼空軍首長未公佈確切數量或交付細節，相關時間仍屬媒體報導，不能當成正式驗收或部署公告。
目前外界對12、24或42架等數量有不同說法，也未釐清採購的是新造J-10CE或二手J-10B。印尼國防部先前否認42架、90億美元合約說法，因此本篇不把那些數字列為已定案訂單。印尼另有Rafale、KAAN與KF-21相關計畫，但其他機型的合約不能補足J-10採購尚未公佈的細節。

en.title: Reports suggest April 2027 arrival for Indonesian J-10 fighters
en.summary: Reports suggest April 2027 arrival for Indonesian J-10 fighters.
body: Indonesia's first Chinese-built J-10 fighters could arrive around April 2027, AeroTime reported from Republika and South China Morning Post coverage. Indonesia's air-force chief did not provide a confirmed delivery quantity or detailed timetable. The timing remains a reported expectation rather than an official acceptance or deployment announcement.

Public accounts differ on quantities and whether the aircraft would be new J-10CE exports or second-hand J-10Bs. Indonesia's defense ministry previously denied a reported forty-two-aircraft, USD9 billion agreement. Those figures should not be treated as a finalized purchase. Separate Rafale, KAAN and KF-21 programs do not resolve the outstanding J-10 contract details.

facts.claim: Reports suggest April 2027 arrival for Indonesian J-10 fighters

body: 民航局10月8日宣佈，8日至12日國內航線預計提供約1,318架次、10.1萬個座位，其中澎湖、金門與馬祖管制航線約1,128架次、9.4萬座位。交通部次長林國顯視察臺北松山機場（TSA）時表示，將視情況啟動疏運ABC計畫。
民航局已協調業者增班，必要時機動加開或放大機型，並與航港局、國防部協調支援；航班仍可能受天候影響，規劃座位數不代表全部保證飛航。旅客如無法搭乘限當日當班的機票，須在起飛前取消訂位，依原票規辦理退票；機場亦加強行動電源與鋰電池攜帶宣導。

en.title: Taiwan CAA plans 101,000 domestic seats for National Day period
en.summary: Taiwan CAA plans 101,000 domestic seats for National Day period.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aviation Administration announced on October 8 that domestic services from October 8 to 12 are expected to provide around 1,318 flights and 101,000 seats. Routes to Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu account for approximately 1,128 flights and 94,000 seats. Officials inspected holiday preparations at Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA).

Airlines have been asked to add flights or use larger aircraft where capacity allows, with maritime and defense support coordinated if needed. The planned totals do not guarantee operation when weather disrupts services. Passengers unable to use restricted tickets should cancel before departure and follow the original fare's refund rules. Officials also emphasized power-bank and lithium-battery carriage requirements.

facts.claim: Taiwan CAA plans 101,000 domestic seats for National Day period

zh.title: LATAM巴西啟動首架E195-E2交付　商業飛航前仍須完成認證
zh.summary: LATAM巴西與Embraer 10月8日宣佈，啟動首架E195-E2交付程序，為年底預計接收12架中的首架。
body: LATAM巴西與Embraer 10月8日宣佈，啟動首架E195-E2交付程序，為年底預計接收12架中的首架。航空公司2025年宣佈最多採購74架此型機；首架投入商業飛航前，仍須完成海關、客艙及巴西民航局ANAC相關程序。
新機136席、採2-2排列，將支援較小與中型市場。初期14架規劃飛42條航線，包括八條新增航線及四個新城市，商業部署安排落在2026年11月至2027年3月。LATAM希望2027年巴西航點突破70個；交付開始、完成營運認證與正式載客必須分開描述，不能以發表儀式當成首航。

en.title: LATAM Brazil begins first E195-E2 delivery process
en.summary: LATAM Brazil begins first E195-E2 delivery process.
body: LATAM Brazil and Embraer announced on October 8 that the delivery process for the airline's first E195-E2 had begun. It is the first of twelve expected by year-end, following a commitment announced in 2025 for up to seventy-four aircraft. Customs, cabin approval and Brazilian ANAC procedures remain necessary before commercial operation.

The 136-seat, two-by-two aircraft will support smaller and medium-sized Brazilian markets. An initial fourteen aircraft are planned for forty-two routes, including eight new services and four additional cities, with commercial deployment scheduled between November 2026 and March 2027. Delivery preparations, operating approvals and revenue service are separate milestones, rather than a completed inaugural flight.

facts.claim: LATAM Brazil begins first E195-E2 delivery process

zh.title: 媒體稱西南航空評估787長程計畫　航空公司尚未宣佈採購
zh.summary: Simple Flying引述路透社消息人士表示，西南航空機隊規劃人員正評估引進787，可能包含二手機，作為首個廣體長程計畫，時間目標約三年。
body: Simple Flying引述路透社消息人士表示，西南航空機隊規劃人員正評估引進787，可能包含二手機，作為首個廣體長程計畫，時間目標約三年。航空公司回應目前沒有即將公佈的機隊消息，因此不能把評估描述為已簽署訂單。
西南目前以737機隊營運，長程旅客可透過Icelandair、Condor等合作業者轉接。媒體另推測Norse Atlantic可能提供二手787，但該來源、數量、租購方式與航線均未獲正式確認。若啟動廣體服務，飛行員協商與營運安排仍須落實；本篇保留報導與公司回應之間的證據界線。

en.title: Reports say Southwest is evaluating 787s; no purchase announced
en.summary: Reports say Southwest is evaluating 787s; no purchase announced.
body: Southwest fleet planners are evaluating Boeing 787 aircraft, including potentially used jets, Simple Flying reported from Reuters sources. The proposal could introduce the airline's first widebody operation on a roughly three-year timetable. Southwest responded that it had no forthcoming fleet-plan news, so no purchase should be treated as announced.

The carrier currently relies on 737s and offers long-haul connections through partners including Icelandair and Condor. Reporting also speculates about Norse Atlantic as a possible source of used Dreamliners. The supplier, quantity, acquisition terms and routes remain unconfirmed. Any widebody service would require further operational and pilot arrangements; the reported assessment is distinct from a signed contract or an approved launch.

facts.claim: Reports say Southwest is evaluating 787s; no purchase announced

zh.title: 國防部稱國慶前夕偵獲19架次共機　13架次越過中線
zh.summary: 國防部10月9日表示，自上午8時52分起，陸續偵獲19架次共軍主、輔戰機及無人機出海，其中13架次逾越臺灣海峽中線，進入臺灣北部、中部與西南空域，並配合共艦活動。
body: 國防部10月9日表示，自上午8時52分起，陸續偵獲19架次共軍主、輔戰機及無人機出海，其中13架次逾越臺灣海峽中線，進入臺灣北部、中部與西南空域，並配合共艦活動。這是當日特定時段的通報，不是全年或整日累計數字。
中央社引述國防部新聞稿，機型包含殲-16、殲-11、蘇愷30、殲轟7、空警500及運-8電子干擾機等。國軍表示運用聯合情監偵掌握動態，派遣任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統應處；通報未列出各型分別架數，也未公佈本次共艦數量，因此不以其他每日通報補填未提供的數字。

en.title: Taiwan reports nineteen PLA aircraft sorties on National Day eve
en.summary: Taiwan reports nineteen PLA aircraft sorties on National Day eve.
body: Taiwan's defense ministry said on October 9 that it detected nineteen PLA aircraft sorties from 08:52 onward, including thirteen crossing the Taiwan Strait median line into northern, central and southwestern airspace. The aircraft operated alongside Chinese naval vessels. The announcement concerns a particular activity period, rather than an annual or full-day cumulative count.

CNA's account lists types including J-16s, J-11s, Su-30s, JH-7s, KJ-500s and electronic-warfare Y-8s, as well as drones. Taiwan said it monitored the activity through joint intelligence and surveillance and responded with aircraft, ships and shore-based missile systems. The release does not provide a separate total for each type or a naval-vessel count for this operation.

facts.claim: Taiwan reports nineteen PLA aircraft sorties on National Day eve

zh.title: 專訪：RTX新加坡航空引擎維修據點導入AI　擴充產能仍須資格認證
zh.summary: AeroTime在MRO Asia-Pacific期間訪問Pratt & Whitney主管Sandra Eich，指出新加坡維修據點正在導入機器人、AI檢查與技術人員訓練，以因應亞太機隊成長。
body: AeroTime在MRO Asia-Pacific期間訪問Pratt & Whitney主管Sandra Eich，指出新加坡維修據點正在導入機器人、AI檢查與技術人員訓練，以因應亞太機隊成長。公司強調AI為協助操作員的工具，並非宣稱可全面取代維修人員。
報導參訪Eagle Services Asia與Collins合資的GASCA，前者展示引擎組裝、自動內視鏡與X光分析，後者採用數位損傷圖與複材維修輔助工具。業者表示，自動化流程仍須完成資格驗證與認證後才能擴大使用；產量與改善幅度是公司訪談說法，不等同已獨立證實的全產業效率。

en.title: Interview: RTX's Singapore MRO sites expand automation
en.summary: Interview: RTX's Singapore MRO sites expand automation.
body: AeroTime interviewed Pratt & Whitney executive Sandra Eich during MRO Asia-Pacific about Singapore's use of automation, AI-assisted inspection and technician training. The company describes AI as an operator-assistance tool intended to support growing maintenance demand, rather than replace every technician.

Visits to Eagle Services Asia and Collins joint venture GASCA highlighted automated engine assembly, borescope and X-ray analysis, digital damage mapping and composite-repair assistance. Executives said automated processes must complete qualification and certification before wider deployment. Reported productivity improvements are attributed to company management and should not be treated as independently verified results for the entire industry. The interview describes ongoing capacity and workforce development, not a blanket regulatory approval.

facts.claim: Interview: RTX's Singapore MRO sites expand automation

zh.title: 專訪：Abra以集團策略整合ESG　兼顧拉美航空連結與生態
zh.summary: AeroTime 10月9日刊出Abra企業責任主管Maria Whittaker專訪，介紹Avianca、GOL與Wamos等品牌如何共同規劃環境、社會與治理策略。
body: AeroTime 10月9日刊出Abra企業責任主管Maria Whittaker專訪，介紹Avianca、GOL與Wamos等品牌如何共同規劃環境、社會與治理策略。Whittaker表示，集團訂定方向，再依各國法規及營運需求保持執行彈性，不能把不同品牌視為所有服務都相同。
專訪聚焦拉丁美洲航空連結需求與亞馬遜、加拉巴哥等敏感生態環境之間的平衡。受訪者認為，航空業除了環境影響，也提供就業、交通與基礎設施價值；這些是公司對ESG策略的說明，並非已取得碳中和認證或可免除排放責任的證明，本篇亦不將策略目標當成完成成果。

en.title: Interview: Abra outlines group-level ESG strategy in Latin America
en.summary: Interview: Abra outlines group-level ESG strategy in Latin America.
body: AeroTime's October 9 interview with Abra corporate-responsibility executive Maria Whittaker outlines an ESG strategy spanning Avianca, GOL and Wamos. Whittaker says the group sets common direction while allowing flexibility for different national rules and operating needs. Shared strategy does not mean the brands provide identical services.

The interview addresses the balance between Latin American connectivity needs and ecosystems such as the Amazon and Galápagos. Whittaker emphasizes employment, transport access and infrastructure alongside environmental responsibilities. These are the company's explanations of its approach, rather than an independent certification of carbon neutrality or proof that aviation emissions have been eliminated. Strategic intentions should remain separate from completed, externally verified outcomes.

facts.claim: Interview: Abra outlines group-level ESG strategy in Latin America

zh.title: 經濟部覈定27案無人機研發補助　漢翔獲1億元最高
zh.summary: 中央社10月9日報導，經濟部覈定27件無人機研發補助，總額約7.8億元，其中漢翔高承載物流無人機計畫獲1億元，為本年度單案最高，金額均為新臺幣。
body: 中央社10月9日報導，經濟部覈定27件無人機研發補助，總額約7.8億元，其中漢翔高承載物流無人機計畫獲1億元，為本年度單案最高，金額均為新臺幣。申請49案、覈定率約55%，支持範圍較去年擴大至整機與關鍵技術。
六件整機案涵蓋長航時垂直起降、物流、農業與水文監測，另21件支持酬載、通訊、動力與飛導控等技術。漢翔計畫聚焦無GPS導航、韌性通訊與自主控制，規劃用於離島運補、救援及偏鄉配送；本次是研發補助覈定，不是產品已完成驗證或獲得商業飛航許可。

en.title: Taiwan approves twenty-seven drone R&D grants; AIDC receives TWD100 million
en.summary: Taiwan approves twenty-seven drone R&D grants; AIDC receives TWD100 million.
body: Taiwan's economy ministry approved twenty-seven drone research grants totaling approximately TWD780 million, CNA reported on October 9. AIDC's heavy-payload logistics-drone project receives TWD100 million, the year's largest individual award. Forty-nine applications were submitted, with about fifty-five percent approved as support expands beyond components.

Six projects concern complete aircraft and twenty-one address technologies including payloads, communications, propulsion and flight control. AIDC will develop GPS-independent navigation, resilient communications and autonomous control for potential island supply, rescue and remote-area delivery. The announcement provides research funding; it does not establish completed product validation, commercial flight approval or the operational readiness of every proposed application.

facts.claim: Taiwan approves twenty-seven drone R&D grants; AIDC receives TWD100 million

zh.title: 美國航空將Starlink計畫擴至全部主線機隊　2027年初開始安裝
zh.summary: 美國航空10月8日宣佈，將Starlink計畫擴至全部主線客機，涵蓋Airbus與Boeing單走道機及Boeing廣體機，合計逾1,000架。
body: 美國航空10月8日宣佈，將Starlink計畫擴至全部主線客機，涵蓋Airbus與Boeing單走道機及Boeing廣體機，合計逾1,000架。安裝預定2027年初開始，這是全主線機隊的未來部署承諾，不是目前全部航機已提供服務。
新計畫擴大先前逾500架Airbus航機的安排，使用Starlink Performance Aero Terminal，官方宣稱最高可達每秒1Gbps。該數字為系統能力說明，不代表每名旅客可保證取得相同速率；主線機隊亦與區域合作航空公司不同，公告未把所有區域航機一併列入，實際航班服務仍須依安裝進度確認。

en.title: American expands Starlink plan to every mainline jet
en.summary: American expands Starlink plan to every mainline jet.
body: American Airlines announced on October 8 that its Starlink plan will cover every mainline jet, including Airbus and Boeing narrowbodies and Boeing widebodies, totaling more than one thousand aircraft. Installations are scheduled to begin in early 2027. The announcement is a future fleet commitment, not confirmation that all aircraft already provide the service.

The expansion builds on an earlier plan for more than five hundred Airbus jets. American cites the Performance Aero Terminal's capability of up to one gigabit per second, which is not a guaranteed speed for each passenger. Mainline coverage is also distinct from regional partners. Availability on an individual flight depends on the subsequent installation schedule.

facts.claim: American expands Starlink plan to every mainline jet

zh.title: JetBlue獲準接手Spirit拉瓜迪亞機場22個時段　交易額5,850萬美元
zh.summary: Aerospace Global News報導，FAA於10月6日覈准JetBlue以5,850萬美元取得前Spirit在紐約拉瓜迪亞機場（LGA）的22個起降時段。
body: Aerospace Global News報導，FAA於10月6日覈准JetBlue以5,850萬美元取得前Spirit在紐約拉瓜迪亞機場（LGA）的22個起降時段。JetBlue此前於破產拍賣勝出，法院7月已批准交易並待監管放行；此次是機場營運權移轉，不是重新完成收購整家Spirit。
時段組合為12個出發與10個抵達許可，不能誤寫為22組來回航班。FAA暫豁免最低使用要求至2027年4月，並限制2028年4月前出租或交易給其他航空公司。JetBlue尚未公佈新增目的地，覈准移轉不代表所有新增航班立即開飛，也沒有增加機場整體允許的營運總量。

en.title: JetBlue secures approval for twenty-two former Spirit LaGuardia slots
en.summary: JetBlue secures approval for twenty-two former Spirit LaGuardia slots.
body: The FAA approved JetBlue's USD58.5 million acquisition of twenty-two former Spirit slots at New York LaGuardia (LGA) on October 6, Aerospace Global News reports. JetBlue won a bankruptcy auction and received court approval in July, subject to regulatory clearance. This transfers operating rights rather than reviving the blocked purchase of the entire airline.

The package comprises twelve departure and ten arrival authorizations, not twenty-two round-trip pairs. Minimum-use requirements are waived through April 2027, with restrictions on leasing or trading the slots before April 2028. JetBlue has not announced destinations, and approval does not mean all additional flights start immediately or increase the airport's overall permitted operations.

facts.claim: JetBlue secures approval for twenty-two former Spirit LaGuardia slots

zh.title: 印度航空業促加速緊急信貸撥付　中東繞飛與燃油成本增壓
zh.summary: Aerospace Global News報導，代表Air India、IndiGo及SpiceJet的印度航空業聯盟致函民航部，要求加速撥付ECLGS 5.0緊急信貸。
body: Aerospace Global News報導，代表Air India、IndiGo及SpiceJet的印度航空業聯盟致函民航部，要求加速撥付ECLGS 5.0緊急信貸。聯盟稱中東空域限制、改道、盧比貶值與航空燃油價格上升，使會員面臨營運及財務壓力。
報導指出，部分業者已收到覈准信貸的一部分，聯盟要求盡快釋出餘額，並提出燃油稅及機場費用等成本改善訴求。這是業者遊說與已覈准額度的撥付要求，不能寫成政府已同意所有減稅措施或全額資金都已到帳；來源所列個別額度單位不清，因此本篇不沿用可能引起誤解的金額。

en.title: Indian airline federation seeks faster release of emergency credit
en.summary: Indian airline federation seeks faster release of emergency credit.
body: The Federation of Indian Airlines has asked the civil-aviation ministry to accelerate emergency credit under ECLGS 5.0, Aerospace Global News reports. Representing Air India, IndiGo and SpiceJet, the federation cites Middle Eastern airspace restrictions, diversions, rupee depreciation and higher aviation-fuel prices as sources of operational and financial pressure.

Some applicants have reportedly received part of approved assistance, while the federation seeks faster release of remaining funds and proposes measures affecting fuel taxes and airport charges. These are industry requests, not confirmation that every proposed tax change has been adopted or all credit has been disbursed. Ambiguous individual funding units in the secondary report are omitted rather than repeated as confirmed amounts.

facts.claim: Indian airline federation seeks faster release of emergency credit
